rows.en:
(Having tea with Michel on the way home
from school like this isn't so ba......)
rows.notes: Cut off mid-word by Klan's shout, as in the Japanese.

rows.en: M... Micheeeeel!!!
rows.notes: Klan's shout; in some occurrences the name plate is missing (PLAYER/none), but the line is hers.

rows.en: Micheeeeeel!!!
(Huh! Klan-senpai?)

Hm? What's up, Klan?
You need something from me?

Don't you "need something" me!
I hear you tried to pick up Claire!

Ah, yeah, a little, the other day.
She politely turned me down, though.

You... you...
Making a move on my friends now, too...!!
rows.notes: omae to iu yatsu wa: exasperated 'You, of all people...'.

rows.en: Come on, calm down, Klan.

I am calm!
If anything, YOU should be panicking more!

Oh nooo~ Klan's mad at me.
Whatever will I do~

Whoops, guess I went a bit too far.
I'd better make a run for it.
Get back here! Michel!!

(Honestly, those two never change.
But more importantly......)

(The bill here...
Does that mean I'm supposed to pay it?)

(Having tea with Michel-kun on the way home
from school like this isn't so ba......)

(Honestly, those two never change.
But more importantly......)

(The bill here...
Does that mean I'm supposed to pay it?)

(Uh-oh, if I don't hurry,
I'll be late for my next class...)

(Hm? Is that Klan-senpai and Pinon-chan?
Looks like they're arguing about something...)

What's going on?
Klan-senpai, Pinon-chan?

What's going on is this, \p!
Pinon is lying, saying she's taller than me.
rows.notes: doumo kou mo nai: 'there's nothing to ask, it's obvious'.

rows.en:
It's not a lie! It's a fact,
so what do you want me to do about it!
And call me Pinon-sensei!!

I'm older than you,
so I can call you by your name just fine.
rows.notes: yobisute: plain name without an honorific.

rows.en:
Besides, the only reason you look taller
is that ribbon on your head...

Wha-!
Why, you...!!
rows.notes: iwasete okeba: 'I let you talk and...'.

rows.en: (What a pointless fight...)

Um, well, if you each just said your height,
I think you'd know right away
which of you is taller...

I see! Now there's an idea!
You say something useful once in a while...
rows.notes: sono te ga atta na: as c01476.

rows.en: Right, I'm 146 cm tall!

Heh, the numbers speak for themselves.
So it's settled that I'm the taller one.

I-I may be losing for now,
but I've still got plenty of growing to do!
I don't want to hear it from you, you've stopped!
rows.notes: Last line: 'from Klan, whose growth has stopped'; Pinon addresses Klan directly, so 'you'.

rows.en:
Ngh! Why, you cheeky little...!
Let me tell you, if I macronize...!!

(Sigh~ If I keep hanging around here,
I'll be late for class. I'd better get back
to the classroom quick.)

(Uh-oh, if I don't hurry,
I'll be late for my next class...)

(Hm? Is that Klan-senpai and Pinon-chan?
Looks like they're arguing about something.)

Ngh!
I-I'm... 142 cm...

Grr! Why, you cheeky little...!
Let me tell you, if I macronize...!

(Sigh~ If I keep hanging around here,
I'll be late for class. I'd better get back
to the classroom quick.)

(I've gotta have as much fun as I can
while it's still summer break.)

Yo, Fresh Boy.
Fancy running into you here.

Oh, hello, Luis-san.
You're downtown at this hour, so does that
mean you're on summer break too, Luis-san?
Nah... I don't have anything like that.

Huh, you're working with no summer break?
That must be tough...
Heh, a guy like me doesn't need summer break...

'Cause for me, every day's like summer break!
Ha ha ha ha ha!!

(That's really not something to laugh about...
Luis-san......)

(I've gotta have as much fun as I can
while it's still summer break.)

Yo, Fresh Girl.
Fancy running into you here.

'Cause for me, every day's like summer break!
Ha ha ha ha ha!

(I get to meet Sheryl Nome, the Galactic Fairy...
I really can't wait for the concert.)

Yo, Fresh Boy.
What's with the happy face?

Oh, Luis-san.
Well, actually, I'm going to be taking part
in Sheryl's concert...
rows.notes: The Pilot Course flies a performance at her concert (nml_kln_002).

rows.en:
Sheryl, huh... She's good...
Her songs have soul.

Wow~ So even you think highly
of Sheryl, Luis-san.

Sure do.
Sorry to ask, but I need you to pass
a message to Sheryl for me.
A message?

Yeah...
Tell her, "I hereby recognize you
as my rival."
Well, I'm countin' on ya.

(Getting a message like that out of the blue
would only confuse Sheryl...)

(I get to meet Sheryl Nome, the Galactic Fairy...
I really can't wait for the concert.)

Yo, Fresh Girl.
What's with the happy face?

Wow~ So even you think highly
of Sheryl, Luis-san.

(Getting a message like that out of the blue
would only confuse Sheryl...)
